column1: # Empty context = plain UI string (tl!, t).
# @plural = plural forms: Turkish has one (a noun stays singular after a number: "3 uygulama").
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of ArtCraft Launcher's English labels in standard Turkish,
# using the terms Turkish users of Windows, macOS and creative software know (Yükle, Güncelle,
# Kaldır, Sürüm, Ayarlar). Sentences address the user with the polite "siz", as Windows and macOS
# do in Turkish; buttons and menu items use the plain imperative.
# Suffixes are never attached to a {placeholder} (Turkish suffixes follow the vowels of the word
# before them, which a placeholder hides): "{v} sürümüne", "{os} için", "Yayımlanma: {date}".
# Coverage: the whole interface — every menu string and tl! literal (complete_menus = true).
# Left in English on purpose: product name "ArtCraft Launcher" (and its "Launcher" tag), suite
# app names (PhotoCraft, LightCraft, FilmCraft, DesignCraft, VectorCraft, PdfCraft, EffectCraft,
# WordCraft, DeckCraft, GridCraft, CADCraft, SoundCraft, FigCraft), "GitHub", "Discord".
